_: Patient expressions for the next Antigravity round, from Gemini's 2026-11-08 sourced table, re-verified by Claude on 2026-11-09: every quote below was fetched from its source and found word for word. Scope chosen by the owner (decision 'gemini-dialect-scope', answer 'core-folk'): core everyday wordings for emergencies form the dialect family; folk-meaning terms form their own family. community_per_source names only what a source states; Gemini's wider attributions are left out where no source supports them.

core.meaning: physical sensation in the heart or chest

sources.quote: "Sinking heart' is an illness in which physical sensations in the heart or in the chest are experienced and these symptoms are thought to be caused by excessive heat, exhaustion, worry and/or social failure.

core.notes: The source describes it as an idiom of distress as well as a body sensation; pair it with cardiac red flags so the clinical level is not in doubt.
